Grammar: can / can't

القاعدة النحوية
📐 Structure – التركيب
TypeFormExample
✅ Positive Subject + can + verb You can buy books at the bookstore.
❌ Negative Subject + can't + verb You can't sleep at the mall.
❓ Question Can + subject + verb? Can I buy a phone at the mall?
💬 Short Answer Yes/No + can/can't Yes, you can. / No, you can't.
🌟 More Examples
🕌
Mosque
You can pray here.
يمكنك الصلاة هنا
🛍️
Mall
You can shop & meet friends.
يمكنك التسوق
🏦
Bank
You can open an account.
يمكنك فتح حساب
✈️
Airport
You can fly to places.
يمكنك السفر
⚠️ Remember: can does NOT change with he/she/it → He can swim. ✅ (NOT "He cans")
can لا تتغير مع المفرد الغائب – She can fly. ✅
✅

Quick Check – Exercise B

تحقق سريع – التمرين ب
📝 Match activities and places – Write the number
طابق الأنشطة والأماكن – اكتب الرقم لكل صورة
Reference: 1=Hotel · 2=Mall · 3=Gym · 4=Bookstore · 5=Bank · 6=Supermarket · 7=Museum · 8=Park · 9=Bus Station · 10=Restaurant · 11=School · 12=Airport
1. You can go shopping and meet friends.
✅ 2 – Mall (مركز التسوق)
2. You can buy books.
✅ 4 – Bookstore (مكتبة)
3. Visitors can sleep there.
✅ 1 – Hotel (فندق)
4. You can open an account.
✅ 5 – Bank (بنك)
5. You can take a bus.
✅ 9 – Bus Station (محطة الحافلات)
6. You can fly to places.
✅ 12 – Airport (مطار)

Pair Work A – Places

عمل ثنائي – إسأل وأجب عن الأماكن
💬 Ask and answer about places
إسأل وأجب عن أسئلة تتعلق بالأماكن
🟠 A:Can I buy a new smartphone at the mall?
🔵 B:Yes, you can.
🟠 A:Can I hang out at the museum with my friends?
🔵 B:No, you can't.
Pattern: Can I/you [activity] at the [place]? → Yes, you can. / No, you can't. النمط: هل يمكنني [نشاط] في [مكان]؟ → نعم / لا يمكنك.
🧩 Quick Quiz – Choose the correct answer

1. Can you sleep at the mall?

2. Can visitors sleep at a hotel?

🙋

Pair Work B – About Yourself

إسأل وأجب عن نفسك
💬 Ask and answer about yourself
تحدث عن نفسك – ماذا يمكنك أن تفعل؟
🟠 A:Can you play tennis?
🔵 B:Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
🟠 A:Do you like to draw?
🔵 B:Yes, I do. And I like to design gadgets.
🔵 B:No, I don't. But I like to make things.
Use: "Can you…?" → ability (قدرة) | "Do you like to…?" → preference (تفضيل) Can you = للقدرة · Do you like = للتفضيل
✏️ Your Turn – اكتب إجابتك
⚽ Can you play football?
🎨 Do you like to draw?
🎾 Can you play tennis?

Lesson Summary

ملخص الدرس

🏙️ Places We Learned

  • Mall – مركز تسوق
  • Hotel – فندق
  • Bank – بنك
  • Bookstore – مكتبة
  • Bus Station – محطة
  • Airport – مطار
  • Museum – متحف
  • Restaurant – مطعم

⚡ Grammar: can / can't

  • You can shop at the mall.
  • You can't fly at a hotel.
  • Can you swim? Yes, I can.
  • Subject + can + base verb

💬 Useful Phrases

  • Can I…? – هل يمكنني…؟
  • Yes, you can. – نعم يمكنك.
  • No, you can't. – لا، لا يمكنك.
  • Do you like to…? – هل تحب…؟

🏷️ Activities ↔ Places

  • Pray → Mosque
  • Sleep → Hotel
  • Buy books → Bookstore
  • Fly → Airport
  • Shop → Mall
